title: How to verify a carrier before moving
meta_title: How to verify a carrier before moving — CargoPT
meta_description: Confirm identity, contact details, applicable qualification, quote, payments and damage procedure.
hero_description: Verification must combine identity, capacity, written conditions and clear answers.
direct_answer_heading: Check who provides the service and what was agreed
direct_answer: Before hiring a carrier, confirm the identity of the person or company, contact details, ability and authorization to perform the work and the conditions of the quote. When applicable to the type of activity, consult the records made available by IMT. Request in writing the service, price, date, payment and expected procedure for damages or changes.
key_points: Confirm name, identification and verifiable contact details.
Check the framework applicable to transport.
Compare vehicle, team and experience with the service.
Ask for a quote and conditions in writing.

sections.heading: Start with identity and contacts
paragraphs: Confirm the name used in the quote, the identification of the company or professional and the contact details.
The data of those who accept the service, receive payment and issue documents must be consistent.
checklist: Name of the company or professional.
Identity of who will perform the service.

sections.heading: Consult applicable records
paragraphs: The road transport of goods for third parties may be subject to its own requirements.
Use the official IMT channels to check the information available about companies and vehicles, considering the type of service and vehicle.

sections.heading: Confirm ability and authorization to perform the work
paragraphs: The existence of contacts or assessments does not replace the verification of the necessary vehicle, team and equipment.
Ask for relevant experience when there are stairs, pianos, appliances or fragile items.

sections.heading: Ask for a clear written quote
paragraphs: The quote must identify the date, locations, inventory, tasks and agreed value.
Confirm that materials, packaging, disassembly, helpers and assembly are included.

sections.heading: Ask how damages and unforeseen events are handled
paragraphs: Ask for a written explanation about the record of damages, complaints, delays, cancellations and changes.
Do not assume that any vehicle insurance automatically covers transported items.

items.title: Damage
items.text: Confirm how they should be documented.

items.title: Coverage
items.text: Ask which risks and limits are actually covered.

items.title: Changes
items.text: Record how additional items or tasks affect the quote.

sections.heading: Recognize warning signs
paragraphs: Be careful with answers that ignore inventory, access, and tasks.
Lack of identification, contradictory conditions or pressure to pay without registration justify additional verification.
checklist: Value presented without questions about the service.
Refusal to confirm tasks in writing.
Contradictory information about team or vehicle.

mid_cta.heading: Compare quotes based on the same order
mid_cta.text: Describe the inventory, access conditions, and tasks to evaluate responses with a common basis.
mid_cta.label: Describe the move

faq.question: Where can I check a shipping company?
faq.answer: Consult the official IMT channels and confirm the framework applicable to the proposed service.

faq.question: Are online reviews enough?
faq.answer: No. Use them only as an additional element to the verified identity, quote and capacity.

faq.question: Is it important to receive a written quote?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration helps confirm tasks, value, date and conditions.

faq.question: Should I pay everything in advance?
faq.answer: Confirm the amount, timing and conditions in writing before making payment.

faq.question: What data should I save?
faq.answer: Save quote, messages, proof, contacts, inventory and relevant photos.
